source.description: Official full-body trajectories fitted to real measured keypoints; fitted joint states are not all directly observed joint measurements.

units_frames.quaternion: wxyz, Hamilton active root-local to world rotation
units_frames.forward: initial root +X projected onto world XY and normalized; signed

source_evidence.lines: 241-253: root_qpos is concatenated unchanged; only initial root XY subtracted
40-43,68-77: egocentric vectors compared to dataset root2site
2-4: radians and gravity 0 0 -981; positive root X front leg anchors at 460 versus hind at 640

units_frames.caveat: HDF5 does not itself provide unit attributes; cm is established by official loader/asset contract and explicit arena cm documentation, not by foot-scale guessing.

selection.method: Search full snippets of endpoint duration 0.5..1.0 s and 0.6 s windows every 25 samples plus final window; require positive forward >0.1 cm, yaw range <=10 deg, abs lateral/forward <=0.15 and >=2 complete swing-peak intervals on every leg. Rank net_forward/(1+4*lateral_ratio+yaw_range_deg/10)*min(1,min_cycles/3).

verification.note: Derivative comparison is diagnostic; native qvel is retained unchanged. Transform roundtrip verifies implementation against official convention, not independent reconstruction of experimental ground truth.

foot_analysis.method: Cadence and signed stride use consecutive smoothed height swing maxima. Five-sample smoothing, >=35 ms separation, local prominence >=max(0.003 cm,0.20*(P95-P05)), +/-40 ms neighborhood. Stride is world XY displacement projected on initial forward; no root-relative displacement substitution.

inferred_plane.equation: z=a*x+b*y+c in cm; perpendicular signed distance retained, including negative residuals
inferred_plane.method: Least-squares fit to each leg lowest 20% world-z samples; inferred lower envelope, not measured ground. Clearance peak-to-trough also reported to reduce plane-offset dependence.

stance_candidate.rule: abs(height)<=0.005 cm AND world foot speed <= max(0.1,0.4*mean signed root forward speed) cm/s
stance_candidate.caution: Kinematic near-plane low-speed candidate only; not measured contact, force, load, support, adhesion, friction or no-slip verification.

selected_clip.definition: t_target=factor*t_reference; qvel_target=qvel_reference/factor. Conservative P99 uses maximum of 42 individual P99, not pooled P99.

all_100_trajectories.definition: t_target=factor*t_reference; qvel_target=qvel_reference/factor. Conservative P99 uses maximum of 42 individual P99, not pooled P99.

retarget_boundary.caution: Homologous names do not establish axis directions, angle zero offsets, limits, morphology or target velocity equivalence. Timewarps are candidate reference slowdowns only; they establish neither physical feasibility nor target tracking. No force measurements or simulation/training performed.
